weekly_world_advance.confidence: CONFIRMED seven-day world-advance behavior; proposed name is descriptive
behavior: Copies persistent profile date from profile+0x9C.
Constructs a seven-day interval and adds it to the copied date.
When profile+0x121 is nonzero, calls 0x00194320, 0x0019E790 and 0x00195DC0 before committing the new date.
Writes the advanced packed date back to profile+0x9C.
Calls 0x0019472C/0x001943C0 housekeeping after the update.
weekly_world_advance.implication: The retail career already has a weekly world-tick boundary suitable for Career Mode 2.0 calendar/world simulation.

population_model.confidence: CONFIRMED loop bounds/record access; exact meaning of every profile count field remains unresolved
evidence: Multiple weekly population routines use profile+0x2A when nonzero.
When it is zero they fall back to 20 records on phase 0 and 50 records when profile+0x121 is nonzero.
All records are accessed through the same 0x001928F0 index getter used by Career Central for the player's current progression record.

annual_aging.confidence: CONFIRMED annual increment behavior; proposed name is descriptive
behavior: Loops the non-player population, skipping the player's current progression record.
Builds a calendar date from record+0x1C modulo 12 plus the current calendar year.
Tests whether that anniversary/birthday boundary falls between the previous and newly advanced dates.
When crossed, increments progression record+0x09 by one.
annual_aging.implication: The retail living world already ages AI boxer records as the weekly calendar crosses their annual date.

retirement_or_inactivation.confidence: CONFIRMED that it evaluates age/record/performance and marks population records inactive; retirement is the strongest semantic interpretation
retirement_or_inactivation.active_flag: progression record+0x00 (0 active; function can write 1 to remove/inactivate)
hard_or_observed_conditions: Requires more than seven completed fights before most checks.
Immediately marks the record inactive when record+0x09 reaches at least 45.
Can mark inactive after at least 21 losses.
Uses win percentage, age/career-span-like values and a random check for additional inactivation decisions.
exclusions: skips at least two other protected/special boxer indices drawn from profile state
retirement_or_inactivation.implication: AI boxer retirement/turnover already exists and can be expanded with health, accumulated damage, titles, form and comeback logic rather than invented from zero.

behavior: Loops the career population and selects records whose scheduled date has become due.

rank_gap_progression.confidence: CONFIRMED rank-pair/phase-dependent magnitude behavior; proposed name is descriptive

On the post-initial/professional side varies the magnitude by rank bands/gaps, returning values including 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12.
Called from the AI bout simulator before subsequent record/progression updates.
rank_gap_progression.implication: The original living world already adjusts progression according to opponent/ranking context rather than only incrementing a static ladder.
